statements.action_statement: The runtime installs Debian's exact fixed package 1:1.3.dfsg+really1.3.2-4 from a signed frozen snapshot and removes libz.so.1.3.1. Debian confirms this version contains the fix: https://security-tracker.debian.org/tracker/CVE-2026-76844 . Trivy's Debian 13 feed currently has no fixed version for that distribution; this statement applies only to the actual patched package, never the old version.

Debian's fixed package includes the same upstream fixing change df84af25dc1942490e1d1c899a07619152a46148: https://security-tracker.debian.org/tracker/CVE-2026-85091 . Runtime smoke verification checks package version, binary checksums, absence of the old library and native image processing before publication.
